Components.Catalog.Note.UseECharts: Part of commercial Kendo UI. Charts use ECharts when needed.

Components.Catalog.Note.UseModal: Popups and confirmations use Bootstrap modals.
Components.TextInputIntro: This family covers short text input, multiline input, and suggestion-enabled controls. Use native Bootstrap inputs for lighter forms, or the Kendo widgets when you want a more unified widget system.
Components.SelectionIntro: This family focuses on checkbox, single selection, multi-selection, and vertical pick-list controls. These are the most common building blocks for filters, metadata, and admin forms.
Components.DateTimeNumericIntro: This family is for date, time, and numeric input that benefits from clearer formatting and culture-aware behavior. The current source can mix native inputs and Kendo pickers depending on form complexity.
Components.GridDataIntro: This section reflects the current source convention: editable grids use Tabulator, while lighter list-data scenarios use Kendo DataSource + ListView + Pager instead of the commercial Grid.
Components.FeedbackPopupIntro: This family groups status messaging, tabbed content, client-side validation, and popup behavior for both lightweight and more focused user interactions.
Components.NavigationLayoutIntro: This family is for small menus, collapsible help areas, and resizable pane layouts. These widgets are useful when building configuration screens or multi-region workspaces.
Components.CatalogIntro: Every component in ToolboxWeb with its library, license, and whether new screens may use it. The data comes from ViewModels/ComponentCatalog.cs; the pills on the demo cards read from it too.

SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.Name: Feature request
SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.Description: Plan a new module with scope, data, acceptance criteria and the project's rules.
SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.InputVariables:
{{feature_description}}: what the feature does
{{user_goal}}: what the user wants to achieve
{{scope_in_out}}: what is in and out of scope
{{data_to_store}}: fields to persist
{{acceptance_criteria}}: how to know it is done
SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.OutputFormat:
1. Solution summary
2. Domain entity and persistence shape
3. Service methods
4. Controller actions
5. ViewModels and Razor views (empty, loading, error states)
6. Localization keys (vi-VN and en-US)
7. Migration impact and data compatibility risk
8. Build and verification steps
SeedPrompt.FeatureRequest.Content:
Context: ToolboxWeb is a server-rendered ASP.NET Core MVC app on .NET 9 with SQLite + EF Core migrations, ASP.NET Identity, Razor views, Bootstrap 5, Kendo UI Core (Apache-2.0 widgets only, no commercial Kendo packages), and Tabulator. The web root is Content/ (not wwwroot). User-facing text comes from Localization/vi-VN.json and Localization/en-US.json. Controllers stay thin, business logic lives in Services/, and every user-owned query filters by UserId. If you can read the repository, read AGENTS.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first.

I need a new feature: {{feature_description}}.
User goal: {{user_goal}}.
Scope (in / out): {{scope_in_out}}.
Data to store: {{data_to_store}}.
Acceptance criteria: {{acceptance_criteria}}.

Constraints: follow the module order in AGENTS.md (Domain, ViewModels, service, service registration, controller, Razor views, activity logging, migration). Follow the UI Standard in AGENTS.md and use Views/Notes/Index.cshtml as the reference list screen. Do not add dependencies outside the license policy.

Respond with:
1. Solution summary
2. Domain entity and persistence shape
3. Service methods
4. Controller actions
5. ViewModels and Razor views (including empty, loading and error states)
6. Localization keys to add (vi-VN and en-US)
7. Migration impact and data compatibility risk
8. Build and verification steps

SeedPrompt.BugReport.Description: Find the root cause of a bug and the smallest correct fix.
SeedPrompt.BugReport.InputVariables:
{{module}}: where the bug happens
{{steps_to_reproduce}}: how to reproduce it

SeedPrompt.BugReport.OutputFormat:
1. Root cause
2. Proposed fix and files changed
3. User isolation, validation and migration impact

I want to change the UI of screen: {{screen}}.
Goal: {{goal}}.
Areas to change: {{areas_to_change}}.
Known pain points: {{known_pain_points}}.

Follow the UI Standard in AGENTS.md:
- Design direction inspired by Linear: neutral surfaces, one accent color, color only for status and feedback, dense lists, roomy forms. Do not copy Linear's logo, icons, colors or CSS.
- Reuse the CSS variables in :root; add no new color literals.
- One page title (topbar), visible labels on every field, confirmation modal for deletes and external writes, empty/loading/error states, minimum 12px text, contrast at least 4.5:1, no text directly on the decorative background.
- Localization keys in both vi-VN and en-US; numbers and dates follow the UI culture.
- Grid convention: center header labels, left-align text, right-align decimal and money, center the rest.
- Works at 1440px and 390px wide, light and dark, with no horizontal scroll.

Respond with:
1. Main UI changes
2. Razor, CSS and JS files to update
